responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/errors/precise_captures.rs: Defines the diagnostic types used to validate and report errors in precise opaque-type capture lists, including missing captures, implicitly captured lifetimes, invalid capture forms, duplicate captures, `Self` alias misuse, and ordering constraints for captured lifetimes and parameters. compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/errors/wrong_number_of_generic_args.rs: Builds and emits the HIR analysis diagnostic for wrong-number-of-generic-arguments errors by classifying missing or excess lifetime, type, and const arguments on a path segment, computing contextual notes about the referenced definition, and generating targeted fix-it suggestions for adding, removing, or rewriting generic arguments.
